title: Customer upgrade decision tree & notification orchestration for LTS + rolling channels
creator: Marco Santoro
description: Problem statement: Customers operating on LTS and rolling release channels need a predictable, low-friction upgrade path and clear, channel-aware communications. Currently our release notes and email/in-app notifications are fragmented across teams and do not encode rollout gates or required actions for operators. This ticket delivers a decision tree and a set of customer-facing artifacts (email templates, in-app banners, staged changelog slices, and a migration checklist) that: 1) articulate upgrade semantics for LTS vs rolling channels, 2) encode rollout gates (metrics and cohorts) so we only notify cohorts when safe, and 3) provide step-by-step migration guidance for customers that need manual actions (config changes, model pinning, KMS rotation).
scope: Cover hosted API customers + Dedicated customers on reserved capacity + Private/VPC customers. Produce canonical comms for: general release notes, targeted migration notices, canary cohort alerts, and post-upgrade verification prompts.
deliverables: Customer-facing decision tree doc (confluence) with channel-specific branches
Email templates for: LTS automatic updates, LTS opt-in reminders, rolling breaking-change advisory, recommended-rollback instructions
In-app banner/cue text snippets and CTA links for guided migrations
Changelog slicing rules (which changes appear to which channel and when)
Migration checklist for Dedicated/Private customers (pinning, quota checks, KMS steps, downtime window guidance)
Rollout gate definitions and signal thresholds for automated notifications
stakeholders: Developer Experience: Sofia Ramos (docs), Priya Shah (console UX)
acceptance_criteria: Decision tree published in Confluence with example flows for LTS minor, LTS patch, and rolling minor releases
A/B tested email templates with open/click targets agreed with Growth
Changelog slicing rules implemented in release pipeline config and validated against last 3 releases
Rollout gates documented and instrumented as monitoring checks (latency, error-rate, model-quality regressions) with thresholds and owners
Migration checklist reviewed and signed off by Security for Private customers
Support and CS runbook created and a 1-hour training session scheduled
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Draft (this ticket): create decision tree + templates + gating proposals
Phase 1 - Internal review: solicit feedback from Eng/RelEng/Security/Support (1 week)
Phase 2 - Pilot: send targeted comms to <5% canary cohort on rolling and 10% LTS early-upgrade cohort; monitor gates for 72 hours
Phase 3 - Ramp: open to 50% cohorts based on gate pass; run live docs and in-app banners
Phase 4 - GA: full channel rollout and update changelog ingestion; schedule postmortem/lesson learned

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-alerting customers for non-actionable patches leading to fatigue. Mitigation: introduce severity mapping and silence policy for <P2 items.
Risk: Private/Dedicated customers require manual KMS steps; mistakes could cause downtime. Mitigation: step-by-step validated scripts + optional hands-on upgrade support offering.
Risk: Gate thresholds too tight causing unnecessary rollback. Mitigation: run synthetic workload tests to calibrate thresholds before pilot.
